en: A sepia-toned vintage postcard depicting a panoramic view of a city with a prominent hill (Schlossberg) topped with historic buildings and a clock tower. At the foot of the hill are riverside buildings facing a wide street, and in the foreground, two baroque church towers rise above the rooftops. The text at the bottom left reads: 'Graz, Kaiser Franz Josef Kai mit Schlossberg.'
